title: Never edit files under generated/
content: The user explicitly stated that no edits should be made to files under the generated/ directory as the build process overwrites them.

title: Fix migration for NOT NULL column
content: To add a NOT NULL column to an existing SQLite table, provide a default value. Modify the schema.sql file to include DEFAULT '' for the owner column.

title: Publishing requires a signed file
content: The `make publish` command requires a `.signed` file, which is only created by the `make sign` command. The sign command currently only creates a placeholder file.

title: Python version check may not exit non-zero
content: The `check_py.py` script exits with code 0 even if the Python version is not newer than the one in the Dockerfile. This may require additional logic to ensure correct exit codes.

title: Implement import window check
content: The script `import_window.py` checks if a given UTC weekday and hour falls within the read-only window (Friday 02:00 to 04:00). It prints 'blocked' during this window and 'ok' otherwise.

title: Deploy target region from config
content: The script `deploy_target.py` reads the region from `deploy.cfg` and prints it. This provides a simple way to retrieve the deployment region from the configuration file.

title: Makefile does not enforce version checks
content: The Makefile does not include any checks for the version number when running `make publish`, so the version is not validated as part of the process.
